sloka: आगता विनिविष्टाः च बलिनः कामरूपिणः ।वानरेन्द्रा महेन्द्र आभा ये मत् विषय वासिनः ॥४-४०-२॥
transliteration: āgatā viniviṣṭāḥ ca balinaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।vānarendrā mahendra ābhā ye mat viṣaya vāsinaḥ ॥4-40-2॥

translations.english: 'The vanaras living in my kingdom have come and have settled down. They are strong and huge like elephants and they can assume any form at will.
